function: above_phy, p. 15: the learned FL DNN outputs legitimate/illegitimate cluster member and secure/unsecure next node (secure multicast routing); STAR-RIS phase shifts come from optimization (19), p. 10.
notes: Excluded (above_phy). The only trained model is the federated DNN of Sec. VI (p. 14-15): its four outputs are legitimate or illegitimate cluster member and secure or unsecure next node (Fig. 13 and Table IV, p. 15), used for secure multicast routing and cluster admission against sinkhole and blackhole attacks. Its accuracy is the RMSE of classifying nodes as secure or unsecured (p. 17). The STAR-RIS phase shifts come from the optimization problem (19a) (p. 10), not from learning. The abstract (p. 1), contribution 5 (p. 3) and conclusion (p. 21) say FL also predicts the STAR-RIS configuration and phase shift, but the method, Fig. 13 and the results show no such output; the reviewer may confirm. Aggregation is digital averaging at the CPU (Eq. 25, p. 14), so area 7 would not apply either.
